positive_findings: All eleven input members, all twenty-one output members, and all three seal members recompute to their recorded SHA256 values. The receipt SHA is exactly 49924dc5...c428 and the candidate RTL SHA is exactly 84b1f3cb...1854.

The four real return-code files are exact ASCII zero records. The compile log names the candidate, SVA, and testbench sources and identifies Synopsys VCS V-2023.12-SP1_Full64. The simulation log has exactly one strict PASS marker and no fatal or assertion-failure signature.

The observed handshake trace contains exactly 20502 events: sixteen configuration observations, six illegal-ID error observations, 10240 accepted inputs, and 10240 ordered outputs. Independent replay reconstructs all 81920 signed56 DUT products with zero mismatch.

All descriptor values 0 through 15 execute. IDs 10 through 15, including lexical value 4'hA, remain unloaded and raise sticky protocol_error; reset recovery is observed after each rejected configuration.

The trace covers all 256 valid masks and the seven signed32 edge values for every legal descriptor. A concrete term-sign connectivity mutant would disagree on 32764 observed products, so the former static sign blind spot is decisively exercised.

Direct independent re-execution of the sealed simv with a fresh coverage database returned zero and reproduced the sealed handshake trace byte for byte. Re-running the snapshotted miter reproduced its JSON byte for byte.

findings.evidence: The runner records its own hash in input_sha256.txt but does not compare INPUTS[4] to a compiled-in expected hash. It snapshots inputs, then invokes VCS, the review validator, the miter, and the receipt builder from the live source tree rather than snapshot/inputs. The VCS executable is selected through PATH. These are reusable-runner TOCTOU and tool-identity attack surfaces.
findings.impact: They do not overturn this sealed run: all current live bytes equal the snapshot, preserved mtimes precede compilation, the VCS-generated database names the expected source paths, and the sealed simv independently reproduces the exact trace. They do weaken hostile-concurrent-environment provenance for future reruns.
findings.required_fix: For the DC/Formality runner, pin the runner self SHA from an external launch receipt, copy first, chmod the snapshot read-only, execute all scripts and filelists from snapshot absolute realpaths, reject symlinked inputs, and resolve and record the exact Synopsys binary path/version before invocation.

findings.evidence: The receipt builder rejects duplicate keys and NaN, but accepts JSON false where mismatches == 0 and false/true where descriptor IDs compare equal to 0/1. It also trusts a structurally plausible m35_r5_trace_miter.json without checking its pinned miter-script/trace/contract/RTL identity or rerunning the miter.
findings.impact: A file replacement between miter and receipt construction could make the reusable builder endorse a fabricated miter. The sealed artifact is not affected because the stored miter has strict integer types, exact expected identities and was independently rebuilt byte for byte.
findings.required_fix: Use type(value) is int for every numeric field, enforce exact schemas and key sets, pin the miter JSON SHA after generation, validate every identity field, and build the receipt in one snapshot-owned process after independently rerunning the miter.

findings.evidence: The run uses one deterministic random seed plus directed extrema, masks, stalls, release attempts, live-ID perturbations, reset-under-stall and nineteen SVA covers. It is not an exhaustive temporal proof over arbitrary ready/valid/reset/config interleavings.
findings.impact: The evidence is sufficient to admit the exact-source VCS milestone and proceed to synthesis/equivalence, but it does not prove all protocol behaviors or an integrated accelerator schedule.
findings.required_fix: Keep the exact-SHA VCS regression and add bounded/unbounded formal protocol properties or several independently sealed seeds before treating the block as reusable production IP.

next_gate.permitted: Run DC/STA and Formality for candidate RTL SHA 84b1f3cb6344863ecfdbac2af8abcfdd15b1f16571979588badbc3e2e0dd1854 with exact constraints/library/source identities and independently sealed tool return codes. Compare same-flow r3/r4 area and timing only after equivalence passes.
next_gate.forbidden: Changing the candidate while inheriting this GO; integrated Local/Motion consumption; PPA, power, energy, system speedup, accuracy, external accelerator comparison, DATE headline, or best-paper claim from this VCS milestone.

claim_boundary.admitted: For exact RTL SHA 84b1f3cb...1854 under Synopsys VCS V-2023.12-SP1: observed all sixteen descriptor IDs; fail-closed IDs 10..15 including 4'hA; 10240 ordered accepted packets; 81920 actual signed56 DUT results checked in-TB and independently replayed with zero mismatch; all 256 masks; per-descriptor signed32 extrema; observed backpressure, empty-boundary release rejection/reload, live-ID perturbation, reset-under-stall, sticky protocol_error/recovery; nineteen nonzero SVA covers; zero observed assertion-failure signatures.
claim_boundary.not_admitted: Exhaustive protocol correctness, DC/STA area or timing, Formality, multiplier cell count after synthesis, PPA, power, energy, SRAM/DRAM behavior, full fixed-point integration, Local/Motion system speedup, accuracy, external comparisons, DATE headline, or best-paper status.
